media.title: Le Matin, 14 December 1934 — Jacques Ibert on the music of Les Nuits moscovites
media.description: “La musique des Nuits moscovites,” Jacques Ibert’s review of the music of Les Nuits moscovites (1934), with a scene still, in Le Matin, 14 December 1934. Ibert praises the score and its use in two scenes played by Harry Baur, but names neither composer; Kaper and Jurmann wrote the film’s songs and had left for Hollywood by the time the review appeared.
media.altText: Le Matin clipping headed “La musique des Nuits moscovites,” with a restaurant scene still from the film above Jacques Ibert’s signed review.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared, and this is the one item in the group with a named author. Jacques Ibert signed the review and died in 1962, so the French term of life and seventy years runs to the end of 2032; the scene still printed above it carries no credit. Published in Le Matin on 14 December 1934, the page was protected in France on 1 January 1996 and the URAA restored United States copyright for ninety-five years from publication, to the end of 2029. Gallica supplies the digitised page under conditions governed by French law, which exclude documents protected by a third party’s copyright and leave reuse in another country to the user.
